programs.desc: Rob Brydon is back in the host’s chair for the award-winning comedy panel show, with Lee Mack and David Mitchell returning as the lightning-quick team captains. Sorting the fact from fiction this time are guests Charlie Brooker, Professor Hannah Fry, Danny Jones and Shaparak Khorsandi.
